description: This file defines the EmployeeWorkExperienceDao class which manages database operations related to employee work experience records in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching work experience data, utilizing Doctrine ORM for persistence and querying.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkExperienceDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for handling employee work experience entities, extending the base DAO with methods for CRUD operations and search functionalities.

methods.name: saveEmployeeWorkExperience
methods.description: Saves an EmpWorkExperience instance to the database, auto-incrementing seqNo if not set, with validation.

methods.name: getEmployeeWorkExperienceById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific employee work experience record based on employee number and sequence number.

methods.name: getExistingEmpWorkExperienceIdsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns a list of sequence numbers for work experiences associated with a given employee, filtered by provided IDs.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeWorkExperiences
methods.description: Deletes specified work experience records for an employee based on sequence numbers.

methods.name: searchEmployeeWorkExperience
methods.description: Performs a search for employee work experiences based on provided filter parameters, returning matching records.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeWorkExperiencePaginator
methods.description: Generates a paginator object for paginated search results based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeWorkExperiencesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employee work experience records matching search filters.
